newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar junk bonds soar on News Corp news.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar junk bonds soar on News Corp news.

text.p: EchoStar Communications Corp high-yield bonds soared 10-12 points in early morning trading on Tuesday, following news that News Corp planned to buy 50 percent of the direct broadcast satellite company, traders said.
"This is what everyone wanted to happen. These bonds are gold right now," said one trader.
EchoStar's 13 1/8 percent zero coupon bonds of '04 were quoted in early trading at 83 on Tuesday, up from 71 1/4 to 71 3/4 on Monday, the trader said.
One trader said other high-yield bonds from other media and telecommunications satellite companies were also being lifted by news of the alliance between EchoStar and News Corp.
TCI Satellite Entertainment (TSAT) bonds opened one point higher, he said. TSAT is a DBS service provider that was recently spun off from Tele-Communications Inc.
The bonds of Globalstar L.P., a partnership of 12 telephone companies building a global mobile satellite telephone system, also opened one point higher, the trader said.
Investment grade traders said News Corp debt was also benefitting from news of the alliance.

Spreads on News America Holdings' 7 3/4 percent debentures of '45 tightened 10 basis points in Tuesday morning trading. Spreads on the issue were 130-125 basis points from around 140-135 yesterday, a high-grade trader said.
